title: Limits

# Limits

**Basic**

$$
\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac1n=0 \qquad \lim_{n\to\infty}\frac1{n^p}=0\ (p>0)
$$

**Same leading power**

$$
\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{n+a}{n+b}=1
$$

**Log continuity**

$$
x_n\to L>0 \Rightarrow \ln x_n\to\ln L
$$

**Sequence convergence**

$$
\lim_{n\to\infty}a_n=L\text{ finite} \Rightarrow a_n\text{ converges}
$$

$$
\lim_{n\to\infty}a_n\text{ does not exist or }=\pm\infty \Rightarrow a_n\text{ diverges}
$$

**Series / partial sums**

$$
S_n=\sum_{k=1}^{n}a_k \qquad \sum_{k=1}^{\infty}a_k=\lim_{n\to\infty}S_n
$$

**Series convergence**

$$
\lim_{n\to\infty}S_n=L\text{ finite} \Rightarrow \sum_{k=1}^{\infty}a_k\text{ converges to }L
$$

$$
\lim_{n\to\infty}S_n\text{ does not exist or }=\pm\infty \Rightarrow \sum_{k=1}^{\infty}a_k\text{ diverges}
$$
